name: PdxAutocomplete
description:
A text input with suggestions whose value is free text: the user can type anything, or pick a
suggestion from a local list or a remote data source.

members.name: suggestions
members.description: The list of suggestions to match against.

members.name: source
members.description: The data source to render from.

members.name: labelField
members.description: Object field used as the visible label.

members.name: valueField
members.description: Object field used as the value.

members.name: placeholder
members.description: Placeholder text shown while empty.

members.name: label
members.description: Visible label text.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Disables interaction and dims the control.

members.name: readonly
members.description: Makes the value read-only — visible but not editable.

members.name: minLength
members.description: Minimum characters before suggestions appear.

members.name: debounce
members.description: Delay (ms) before querying after a keystroke.

members.name: forceSelection
members.description: Require the value to be one of the suggestions.

members.name: highlight
members.description: Highlights the matched substring in suggestions.

members.name: clearable
members.description: Shows a clear button to reset the value.

members.name: loading
members.description: Shows a loading / busy state.

members.name: name
members.description: Form field name, submitted with the form.

members.name: maxItems
members.description: Maximum number of suggestions to show.

members.name: remote
members.description: Enable server-side filtering via DataSource.setFilter() with debounce.

members.name: error
members.description: Marks the control as invalid.

members.name: success
members.description: Applies the success state styling.

members.name: warning
members.description: Applies the warning state styling.

members.name: size
members.description: xs, sm, md (the default), lg or xl — the same scale as pdx-input.

members.name: value
members.description: The model's value. A form submits it: a picked suggestion's value, not the label shown; free text as typed (#135).

members.name: show
members.description: Open the popup.

members.name: close
members.description: Close the popup.

members.name: toggle
members.description: Open the popup when closed, close it when open.

members.name: clear
members.description: Clears the value.

members.name: getText
members.description: The text the field shows: the picked suggestion's label, or the free text.

members.name: getSelectedItem
members.description: The suggestion last picked, as given; null when the value is free text or set from outside.

events.name: query-change
events.description: The text typed, on each keystroke: the query the suggestions are filtered by.

events.name: pdx-clear
events.description: Fired when the clear button empties the field, after its `value-change`.

events.name: open-change
events.description: The popup opened (`true`) or closed (`false`): its open state, read-only, as an overlay's (#287).

events.name: value-change
events.description: Fired when the component writes `value`. Does not bubble.

slots.name: option
slots.description: Renders one option: a snippet `option(option, index, highlighted)`; `option.raw` is the original item.
slots.signature: (option: { label: string; value: unknown; raw: T }, index: number, highlighted: boolean)

cssParts.name: root
cssParts.description: The frame: border, background and the states' colours.

cssParts.name: clear
cssParts.description: The clear button, while `clearable` and something is typed.

cssParts.name: popup
cssParts.description: The floating panel that holds the list.

cssProperties.name: --pdx-input-border-color
cssProperties.description: The trigger is the text input's frame, `.pdx-input-wrap`, and reads pdx-input's tokens (#761): its border at rest (the outlined input style).

cssProperties.name: --pdx-input-border-color-focus
cssProperties.description: The frame's border while focused (the outlined input style).

cssProperties.name: --pdx-input-border-color-invalid
cssProperties.description: The frame's border in the invalid state.

cssProperties.name: --pdx-input-border-color-success
cssProperties.description: The frame's border in the success state.

cssProperties.name: --pdx-input-border-color-warning
cssProperties.description: The frame's border in the warning state.

cssProperties.name: --pdx-input-border-width
cssProperties.description: The frame's bottom border, in the filled input style.

cssProperties.name: --pdx-input-focus-ring
cssProperties.description: The ring around the frame while focused.

cssProperties.name: --pdx-input-min-height
cssProperties.description: The frame's height, at the md size.

cssStates.name: loading
cssStates.description: `loading` is set, or the DataSource is loading.
